_comment_drv_closure: DRV (max slew / max cap) closure, SGE job 5105 (t4b), 2026-08-27. Baseline job 4780 signed off with 1060/115 max-slew/max-cap violations at nom_tt (1963/160 at SS) because the only DRV repair ran on estimated parasitics and found the design ~clean. Enabling the post-GRT resizer-timing pass plus widening the design-repair slew/cap margins to 65% drops that to 10/4 (nom_tt) / 15/6 (SS), DRC/LVS clean, WNS unchanged (SS actually -16.97 -> -15.71). Do NOT add set_max_transition/set_max_capacitance to the SDC to push further: any design-wide value stalls repair_design on this netlist for 70+ min (trials t3/t5/t6). Residual ~15 pins are a documented waiver (quasi-static MCP-relaxed sc_detector-decode / training_acc cones + 2 output-path buffers).
_comment_a40: A40 padframe integration. Pin placement comes from the integrator floorplan template A40_ACV_rtlnames.def (A40_ACV.def; RTL port names now match the generator's <pad>_<terminal> convention verbatim after commit 6c50e12, so no rename map is applied - the script only drops the VDD/VSS pin entries, which the PDN builds, and appends the 68 die-internal Grouper GRP_* / AHB H* / IRQ_GROUPER pins on the south edge at synthetic coords). Die follows the template: 1675x1110 (not Trouper's own 1650x1100). IO_PIN_ORDER_CFG is unused in this flow - io_placement_bl.cfg is kept only as the standalone (non-padframe) pin order.
_comment_antenna_port: Antenna closure ported onto the A40 padframe flow, 2026-08-29. Job 5198 reached ZERO antenna violations at 1675x1110 with config_1675_c5_diodepad4.json, but that config drove pins via IO_PIN_ORDER_CFG (io_placement_lshape_1675.cfg), NOT the A40 FP_DEF_TEMPLATE this flow uses -- so the result is not known to transfer and this run is what proves it. Ported exactly three knobs from c5: DIODE_PADDING 4, DPL_CELL_PADDING 3->2, and GRT/DRT_ANTENNA_REPAIR_JUMPER_ONLY true->false. DPL_CELL_PADDING must drop to 2: c5 records that 3 causes DPL-0036, diodes failing to legalize at all. PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT deliberately stays at the canonical 72 (c5 ran 65) so only the antenna knobs vary. GRT_ANTENNA_REPAIR_MARGIN 90 is kept from canonical. This run is also the first through P&R with the 2 MHz SPI SDC (create_clock SPI_SCK 500ns + async clock groups, absent from every previous final/) and the renamed A40 ports.
